raw_response: {"diagnosis": "85 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions casts amount as-is, so EUR amounts are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has a single EUR rate (1.25, as_of 2026-01-01), so the conversion can be determined.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON r.currency = f.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
